[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-pw[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Meeting notes become event-linked references[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]One deliberate gesture, from the CLI, Obsidian, or Bob Mac Capture,[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]files AI meeting notes (Wispr Flow first, any producer) as a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`meetings` reference. The reference is filed under the meeting's [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]area or project, gets a searchable recap and a polished dossier [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]PDF, and has a Next reading task related `notes from` its Event [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Task. The `~/tmp/bryan_derrick_meet_notes.txt` notes are filed onto[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`20261123#^bryan-bugyi-derrick` this way as the first use case.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202611/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]meeting_notes_event_refs.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/meeting_notes_event_refs.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-pw[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-pw/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Structural notes normalizer, dossier source, and recap [/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]renderer[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]notes-normalizer[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]notes-normalizer: pure Rust module that reads notes text, detects its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]shape, builds a MeetingNotes model without changing a word, and renders [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the round-trippable dossier Markdown plus the inert, digest-stamped [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]recap region, with synthetic golden fixtures.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Event Task resolution, matching, recent-meetings listing, and [bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]agenda notes state[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]meeting-resolver[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]meeting-resolver: read-only meetings module that resolves EVENT tokens, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]scores auto-matches with evidence, lists recent Event Tasks with their [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]filed-notes state, looks up Google identity, resolves the parent or [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]inbox, and adds the additive notes state to the capture agenda's event [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rows.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Meeting dossier print profile[/bold #D7AFFF]                                 [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]dossier-print[dim] · [dim][/dim]after notes-normalizer[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]dossier-print: a meeting print profile beside the note-snapshot profile [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](shared fonts, glyph coverage, warnings) that renders the dossier [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Markdown into a one-to-two-page PDF with a title card, TL;DR box, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]next-steps table, sections, provenance, and an optional transcript [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]appendix.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Marker-carried meeting identity births the LINKS relation and [bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]recap[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]meeting-birth[dim] · [dim][/dim]after notes-normalizer[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]meeting-birth: intake and sync births for a meetings PDF whose marker [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]carries `event` give the reading task a LINKS child and seed the note's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]recap from the birth store, byte-identical whether ingested inline or [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]later by `bob ref scan`.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The `bob ref meet` command[/bold #D7AFFF]                                    [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]ref-meet-cli[dim] · [dim][/dim]after meeting-resolver, dossier-print, meeting-birth[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ref-meet-cli: the CLI leaf wiring resolver, normalizer, print profile, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and birth into the create/intake pipeline, with list mode, dry run, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]editor review, clipboard/stdin intake, dedupe and overwrite, inbox [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]re-root, the JSON contract, the receipt, `meetings:` config, catalog [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rows, and docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]File the first meeting's notes[/bold #D7AFFF]                                [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]first-use[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ref-meet-cli[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]first-use: run the new command on the real notes file against the live [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]vault, verify every artifact (including the PDF visually), retire the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]hand-built review chain per the scaffolding decision, and record [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]deferred follow-ups.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Obsidian surfaces for meeting notes[/bold #D7AFFF]                           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]obsidian-surfaces[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ref-meet-cli[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]obsidian-surfaces: bob-plugins adds a Command Mode FOR THIS NOTE row for[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the Event Task under the cursor, a `ref-meet` outcome adapter, and a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Reading Board meetings kind, then deploys with `bob plugins sync`.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bob Mac Capture meeting-notes mode and Meetings kind[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]mac-surfaces[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ref-meet-cli[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-surfaces: bob-mac-capture adds a Meeting Notes mode (hotkey, menu [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]item, and a Notes action on ended agenda rows) that previews and files [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]clipboard notes through `bob ref meet` JSON, plus a first-class Meetings[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]kind in Bob Refs, gated green on macOS CI.[/#D7D7AF]
